source.name: Calcio e Finanza: I ricavi da sponsor di maglia in Serie A: il Napoli vola al quinto posto, Milan in vetta
source.quote: 5 – Sassuolo – Mapei: 18 milioni di euro a stagione
source.note: Translation: '5 – Sassuolo – Mapei: 18 million euros per season'. Press estimate of 2026-27 main shirt-sponsorship revenue. The same article notes Mapei is a 'related party': it is owned by the Squinzi family, which runs the club.

note: Reported value of the Mapei front-of-shirt deal for 2026-27. The article counts Mapei among the 'parti correlate' (related parties): it is owned by the Squinzi family, which runs the club, so this is a related-party arrangement rather than a market deal.
